question.text: The correct order of reactivity of the given chlorides with acetate in acetic acid is :

solution.text: The given compounds in Acetate in Acetic acid solution reacts through <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></msub><mn>1</mn></math> mechanism. The stability of carbocation is directly proportion to reactivity via <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></msub><mn>1</mn></math> mechanism.
